user.description: Enter the IP address of any TIS IP gateway on this network. Home Assistant asks every TIS module to identify itself; nothing is switched.

data_description.host: The IP address of a TIS IP gateway, for example 192.168.1.50. Modules behind other gateways on the same network are found too.
data_description.port: The TIS bus port. Leave at 6000 unless the installer changed it.

error.no_devices: No TIS dimmers answered. Check the gateway address and that Home Assistant is on the same network as the gateway.

cannot_connect.message: Could not open the TIS bus connection to {host}
